criteria.contract: Explicit v19 local same-version surrender agreement requires the player incumbent head/control, a physically present consenting foreign commander and actual registered army; confirmation alone does not occupy the castle

Gate handover and scheduled keep handover are separate physical steps; existing owner forces/relief at the keep or absent recipient block the remaining handover, and already transferred gate possession is never rolled back

Military possession never transfers original land ownership, memberships, service bonds, soldiers, house grain, private money, contracts or salary debts; warehouse/property remain explicitly outside the handover

Only the local participants can perform and observe handover; remote view shows dated own witness records and never current remote troops/stores; the game distinguishes military possession from recorded ownership

Invalid/stale/duplicate/tampered agreements, relief timing, partial withdrawal and actual generation recovery/future equality are tested; old versions keep original bytes and headless3D projection is separate from GUI/appearance

limits: Explicit v19 only. Player incumbent head offers a local same-version handover to a consenting physically present foreign commander with an existing registered army. Warehouse/property, ownership, memberships, services, officers, soldiers and debts are outside the handover. Gate/keep are logical sectors at the same current world site; not general castle collision geometry or completed siege warfare. No general NPC surrender strategy, legal annexation, succession or asset inheritance. All current1366 related tests passed; full3276/GUI NOT_RUN.
